title: files.upload stops working and returns method_deprecated after the November 2025 sunset
symptoms: Old file upload scripts and SDK calls to files_upload fail while chat.postMessage still works
New apps created after 2024-05-16 never had access to files.upload
cause: Slack retired files.upload in favor of a two step external upload flow. Apps created after 2024-05-16 lost it first, and the method stopped working for everyone on 2025-11-12.
fix: Switch to files.getUploadURLExternal plus files.completeUploadExternal, or the SDK v2 helpers (filesUploadV2 in Node, files_upload_v2 in Python).
affected: Slack Web API, all apps from 2025-11-12; apps created on or after 2024-05-16 earlier
